interpretation: At the identical completed original-goal request, parent returns DONE under both precisions; child returns Back4 in NF4 and DONE in BF16. The observed child stopping regression depends on deployment composition in this fixed-input comparison.
At the identical Nature post-SELECT request, parent returns premature View8 in NF4 and correct TYPE_TEXT4 in BF16. Child selects TYPE_TEXT4 in both.
At the prematurely opened Nature detail, parent falsely returns DONE in both precisions while child correctly chooses Back4 in both. Precision alone does not explain all semantic failures.
The known category-only Nature training control returns DONE in all four rows. This is a familiar training control, not generalization evidence.
Child BF16 agrees with all four external next-action labels; this is not four browser task successes and does not establish 13-case completion or a competitor win.
limits: Four deliberately selected saved development/failure/training inputs are not a holdout or a browser suite.
Only within-identical-request adapter/precision comparisons are controlled. Across-case differences include goals, authentic historical profile URLs, page state and history.
The category-only control is a known parent training row and retains its actual profile URL. The original425 parent URL confound remains disclosed.
BF16 and NF4 use distinct verified loading compositions and numerical modules; do not infer a universal quantization-only cause from four greedy requests.
Shared GPU workload and setup/hash/invariant costs prevent a controlled latency or throughput superiority claim.
